purpose: Run queries supported by supplied data with explicit input availability; retain strict full-snapshot acceptance.
sourceUniverse: Actual basic quote rows on evaluation date and requested market
sourcePublication: Disclosed full-snapshot relationship and price-range warnings
runtimeIdentity: Per required source: row count and project-source-definition-v1 metadata hash. VIEW hash includes SHA2(VIEW_DEFINITION,256); all sources include ordered COLUMN_NAME,COLUMN_TYPE,IS_NULLABLE,ORDINAL_POSITION. External data writes require fresh publication.
queryAvailability: Before predicates, ranking and LIMIT: observed securities, missing current extension rows, computed NULL inputs, count-horizon unknown conditions and up to 20 missing-input samples.
countHandling: Keep frozen CONS/EXIST behavior: unknown conditions do not count as hits; insufficient observed rows produce NULL count result. Report unknown horizon inputs separately.
unmatchedExtensionHandling: Retain all raw rows. Do not manufacture basic prices or map to another date; cross-source query population is anchored on basic quotes.
unsupported: Industry and membership without a validated source
execution: Explicit trusted local --project-validation flag on execute/serve; read-only account, scan estimates, memory/query/queue/return limits remain enforced; raw access without unvalidated feature materializations. Finite position-only queries retain the maximum required actual observations, including NULLs, before expensive decimal windows; unbounded/mixed/counted queries keep full reference lowering.
strictAcceptance: No change to full-snapshot gates, VALIDATED registry or formal benchmark entry points. External blind tests and official field definitions remain unverified.
